limits: Three enrolled participants and ten shooting dates. Both split protocols reuse photos across protocols.
Fixture thresholds were selected during this audit. There is no independent additional population for production calibration.
Photo aliases were deduplicated. Different original files can be adjacent frames from one capture sequence.
A separate exploratory time split uses the first half of dates as references and is not an independent population.
Body-specific replay enrols only other verified camera bodies. The desktop searches the full confirmed gallery.
No person names, identifiers, photos, pathnames or embedding vectors are published.
